data.description:
## Incident Overview

ci.yml:779-785 red-test-blocker only matches session/, session-, session_, bug-batch/ on github.head_ref. worktree-* branches are not matched, allowing RED-phase tests to merge to main.

**Fix**: Add startsWith(github.head_ref, 'worktree-') to the conditional.
**Probe**: Open PR from worktree-* branch with RED marker, verify step skipped.
data.title: ci: red-test-blocker does not match worktree-* branches -> RED markers can reach main
